# GEO report: atlas-roadmaps **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 40/100, Unconfirmed Confidence: High (checked 23 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 11.25 ÷ 23 × 100 = 49. High = (11.25 + 0) ÷ 23 × 100 = 49. The raw score is capped at 40 because `Bingbot` is blocked site-wide despite the declared AI-search policy allowing crawlers. The code review found no runtime/CDN evidence. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Allow search crawlers that the policy permits - **Why it matters:** Bing and other search systems cannot crawl the public routes. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:5-6` - **What the code says:** `"User-agent: Bingbot\nDisallow: /"` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 75/100 ### 2. Declare the sitemap in robots.txt - **Why it matters:** Crawlers may not discover the otherwise valid sitemap automatically. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:1-9` - **What the code says:** `"User-agent: *\nAllow: /\nDisallow: /dashboard\n\nUser-agent: Bingbot\nDisallow: /\n\nUser-agent: GPTBot\nDisallow: /"` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 84/100 ### 3. Add a canonical URL to the pricing route - **Why it matters:** Canonicals tell crawlers which URL is the authoritative version of a page. - **Where:** `app/routes/pricing.tsx:1` - **What the code says:** `"export default function Pricing() { return

Pricing

Plans that grow with your team. Talk to us for a quote.

; }"` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 90/100 ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | Reachable, valid robots.txt | Clear | `public/robots.txt:1-9` | | GEO-009 | Search crawler access matches policy | Problem | `geo.config.json:1`; `public/robots.txt:5-6` blocks Bingbot | | GEO-014 | Sitemap and linked routes are indexable | Problem | 4 public routes are blocked for Bingbot; `public/robots.txt:5-6` | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on the declared origin | Problem | Pricing lacks one; `app/routes/pricing.tsx:1` | | GEO-003 | Primary content in server HTML | Problem | Changelog entries load client-side; `app/routes/changelog.tsx:5` | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD parses and meets requirements | Not applicable | No JSON-LD found | | GEO-011 | Discoverable, valid sitemap | Problem | Sitemap exists, but no `Sitemap:` line; `public/robots.txt:1-9` | | GEO-012 | Title, description and HTML language | Problem | Pricing inherits generic root metadata; `app/root.tsx:2`, `app/routes/pricing.tsx:1` | | GEO-016 | Key routes have server-rendered links | Problem | Features uses client navigation; `app/routes/_index.tsx:9` | | GEO-017 | Snippet restrictions match AI-search policy | Clear | No `nosnippet`, `max-snippet:0` or `X-Robots-Tag` found | | GEO-002 | Selected accessibility checks | Clear | Read `app/root.tsx` and all five route components | | GEO-101 | Mobile app association files | Not applicable | No app profile declared | | GEO-010 | `llms.txt` presence (informational) | Not applicable | No file or route found; not scored | | GEO-102 | App-specific structured data (informational) | Not applicable | No app profile declared; not scored | ## Other problems found None found. ## Worth considering - **Explain the integrations claim:** `app/routes/_index.tsx:8`: `"Integrates with all the tools you already use."` Add the supported integrations or link to a concrete integrations page. - **Add pricing details:** `app/routes/pricing.tsx:1`: `"Plans that grow with your team. Talk to us for a quote."` State what plans include, or link to a contact/demo route. - **Expand feature descriptions:** `app/routes/features.tsx:2`: `"Timelines, sharing and status updates."` Add concise explanations or dedicated pages for each feature. - **Expose changelog dates and authors:** `app/routes/changelog.tsx:6` renders only entry strings. Include release dates and authors when those facts exist. - **Add sitemap modification dates:** `public/sitemap.xml:3-6` contains no `` values. Add real dates if release or page-update dates are maintained. - **Add explicit head basics:** `app/root.tsx:6`: `""`. Confirm or add explicit charset, viewport and social preview metadata. - **State site identity structurally:** No JSON-LD was found. Consider `Organization` or `WebSite` data using the existing Atlas identity and site origin. ## Can't tell from code - **Live HTTP status and redirects:** Confirm with a live scan of the site URL. - **Runtime changelog content:** `app/routes/changelog.tsx:5` depends on `/api/changelog`; confirm that endpoint returns useful server-rendered content. - **Headers and CDN rules:** Repository code cannot show externally added `X-Robots-Tag`, firewall rules or CDN crawler blocking. - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. ## Assumptions - You want public pages discoverable by search engines and AI-search crawlers. - `/dashboard` is intentionally private because it is both disallowed in robots.txt and marked `noindex`. - The four sitemap URLs are the main public routes. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any search or AI product.
